originalPaperLinkOnly.access_note: Publicly indexed full text verified through primary-source search; direct PMC fetch currently presents browser challenge and Wiley direct fetch returned 403. Do not describe direct retrieval as successful. No article file copied.

originalPaperLinkOnly.evidence_summary: Development validation: 6,000 patients across eight primary-care and seven obstetrics/gynecology clinics; criterion interview subgroup 580 primary-care patients. Threshold >=10: sensitivity 88%, specificity 88% for major depression against independent mental-health-professional interview. Severity lower bounds 5,10,15,20. These are not population norms or a self-administered diagnosis.
